title: [LOGGED OUT] Phone "Add It to Home Screen" banner text has no spelling mistakes
reason: Banner second line has a typo: "To got a quicker access !"

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ in the browser with phone emulation (iPhone 14 size, 390x844) and wait until the page has finished loading.
If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
Is a bottom banner with "Add It to Home Screen" shown?
steps.saw: Bottom banner "Add It to Home Screen" with Claim and X shown

steps.text: Is the second line spelled correctly (for example "To get quicker access!", not "To got a quicker access !")?
steps.saw: Second line reads "To got a quicker access !" (wrong word "got", extra "a", space before "!")

steps.text: Close the banner with its X button. Do not click "Claim".
steps.saw: Clicked X (Close pwa banner); banner gone, Claim not clicked
